digest.component_or_area: Code quality automation and lint gate infrastructure
propositions: Automated-quality audit identified approved maintainability ratchets blocking wholesale enforcement due to existing diagnostics requiring remediation before gate activation.
Function complexity C901 ratchet must be staged with a symbol-level baseline at threshold 15 before enabling as a canonical lint gate.
Four Mypy settings (no_implicit_optional, strict_equality, warn_redundant_casts, warn_unused_ignores) require measured diagnostic revalidation before enforcement.
Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rules must be enabled after making three datetime sites timezone-explicit and creating shared ratchet test coverage.
Ruff RUF rule family must be narrowed to approved diagnostics, deferring RUF001/RUF002/RUF003 and clearing RUF100, with all gates verified green against current origin/main before land.
